title: High-index facet NiFeB@H-NiFeBO core–shell nanowires for a highly efficient oxygen evolution reaction in water splitting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00859J, Paper
Xing Wang, Wei Pi, Yu Qiu, Zhangquan Gong, Jinchang Fan, Haifeng Bao, Na Yao, Xiaoqiang Cui
A novel core–shell  NiFeB@H-NiFeBO nanowire catalyst with an exposed high-index facet (HIF) outer layer simultaneously boosts OER stability and activity by activating lattice oxygen and stabilizing *OO-VO during the OER process.
